summary: This resolution expresses the sense of the House of Representatives that creators and digital workers deserve fair treatment, transparency, and economic opportunity, advocating for portable benefits, clear revenue sharing, direct audience relationships, small business resources, and protections against misclassification and harmful AI use.

scores.thoughts: The bill advocates for transparency regarding platform algorithms, data access for creators, and consent/accountability standards for AI and synthetic media, all of which relate to how technology is used and how personal data/identity is handled. It also mentions privacy protections in the context of creators maintaining direct communication with audiences.
